title: Defenders and Martyrs
summary: How Defenders guard what they value, and how that differs from Martyrs.

claims.text: Before the imbuing, Defenders tend to value something as much as life itself, a family, ethic, culture, place, creation or community, and their first answer to monsters is to protect it.
Defenders draw a line and fight hard for it but are not reckless: they plan, retreat when schemes fail and accept losing one charge to stay alive and save more.
Martyrs also guard people and places, but give of themselves with abandon, while Defenders weigh what to save and try to wear the enemy down.

title: Defender slang
summary: Terms Defenders use for hunters and the hunt.

claims.text: Defenders call themselves hunters, and sometimes protectors, guards or champions; their purpose is the watch, also known as the mission or the calling.
A kamikaze throws life away in the hunt with nothing saved; a recluse is a protector gone over the edge who guards something outside normal society; runaways are witnesses who fled at an imbuing.
